policies.title: Czech ordinary passports: Botswana visa-free visits
policies.summary: Czech MFA guidance records Botswana's Foreign Ministry confirmation that ordinary Czech passport holders need no entry visa.
conditions: The confirmation is limited to a valid ordinary Czech travel passport and entry; it does not establish work, residence, special-passport, carrier or final-admission conditions.
The result follows Botswana's direct confirmation to the Czech mission, not inference from the eVisa portal.

policies.title: Czech ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Czech MFA guidance says ordinary Czech passport holders may visit Panama visa-free for up to 90 days when not undertaking paid work.
conditions: The stated ordinary-passport waiver is for stays up to 90 days and excludes gainful activity.
Passport validity, extension, work, residence, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Czech ordinary passports: Tunisia visa-free tourist visits
policies.summary: Czech MFA guidance says Czech nationals need no entry visa for tourist stays in Tunisia of up to 90 days.
conditions: This is the ordinary Czech-passport tourist baseline for stays not exceeding 90 days.
Longer stays, work, residence, special passports, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Czech ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's Special Branch makes tourists from European countries eligible to obtain a visa on arrival at Dhaka; this includes Czech ordinary-passport holders.
conditions: This is the named European-country tourist category for a single-entry arrival visa at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport, for a maximum of 30 days.

Bangladesh says the immigration officer issues the visa after reviewing compliance; required travel documents, funds and final admission remain separate. Work, residence, special passports and third-country-document routes are excluded.

policies.title: Czech ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board lists Czech nationals as eligible for a visa obtained on arrival.
conditions: The named Czech table entry says the visa is obtained on arrival and gives a 40 JOD fee; it is not reclassified as eVisa merely because Jordan also offers an electronic service.
Entry point, passport validity, onward travel, work, residence, special-passport, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.
